paragraphs: The 428i/430i has been a mainstay of the 4 Series petrol range from 2013 to 2020, covering the F32/F33/F36 generation. Early cars (pre-2016) use the N20 — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine. From 2016, the 428i/430i switched to the B48, a newer generation of four-cylinder petrol engine that's a different unit entirely, not an evolution of the N20. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components, the known wear pattern, and even the rebuild specifics differ between them — which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting. The 428i/430i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The 428i-430i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the 428i/430i from 2013 to 2016. Known for timing chain guide failure over time — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, guides, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every N20 rebuild.
The later 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine, fitted from 2016 onwards. A genuinely more reliable design with no equivalent to the older engine's timing chain guide pattern.

compatibility.intro: Because the 428i/430i spans two distinct engines across one generation, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an N20 part will work on a B48 car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (N20 or B48) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic 428i/430i quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
